# P37.71 — Single-operator true-deletion path (WV-06) + the operator-only purge function, the sole SIG-STORE-011 exception (WV-11)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/429_P37.71__single-operator-deletion-and-purge-function.md` (manifest row 429, R11-GOV-06)
**Stack:** on `r11/P37.8-legal-demand-posture-and-counts` · **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent

Design first, then a mechanism that keeps the audit record. **The mechanism is built and fixture-verified on a clone only — never run, never deployed, the operator-held role never granted.** The `hosted` deploy of the `operator_purge` sqitch change and every single use are separate never-pre-authorised in-ticket gos (`D-P37.71-1`).

## What landed

- `docs/governance/true-deletion-and-purge.md` — the design note: WV-06/WV-11 verbatim; the B-14 (365-day *unlocked* retention, ADR-177) × OCFL write-once (ADR-023) reconciliation — a governance-mode delete removes the material and keeps its own audit record; scope = SIG-GOV-008, suppression (SIG-GOV-007) stays the primitive for everything else.
- `db/deploy|revert|verify/operator_purge.sql` + `db/sqitch.plan` tail (no landed change edited):
  - `sig_purge_operator` — NOLOGIN role, created but membership **never granted** by any migration;
  - `purge_tombstone` — append-only public-safe tombstone (category + date + count, never content; immutability trigger + `spine_watermark` facet; `sig_read_public`/`sig_export` SELECT);
  - `purge_audit` — append-only restricted audit record (authorisation + act);
  - `sig_purge_claims()` — SECURITY DEFINER, EXECUTE only to `sig_purge_operator`; refuses any invoking role that is not `sig_purge_operator` verbatim (`current_setting('role')` else `session_user` — strict equality, superuser-safe); refuses empty/bad inputs; refuses any claim a recorded decision or cross-reference outside the set points at (suppress instead); deletes the claim bundle (`claim` + `claim_evidence` + `claim_qualifier` + `claim_lineage`) inside one transaction with only USER triggers disabled — FK triggers stay armed; tombstone + audit land first.
- `db/src/db/operator_purge.py` + `sig-db purge` — the claim-leg caller.
- `ops/src/ops/operator_deletion.py` + `sig-ops deletion plan|execute|verify` — governed object deletions (evidence bytes, restricted objects, derived artifacts) under `sig.deletion-order/1` + `sig.operator-authority/1` (verified, never created — SIG-SEC-010); emits `sig.deletion-tombstone/1` + `sig.deletion-audit/1` + the `sig.editorial-decision/1` entry for the public log + a `sig.deletion-receipt/1`; the verify leg emits `sig.probe-run/1`.
- `docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md` §14, root `AGENTS.md` (gotcha 5 + Forbidden line now name the sole exception), `db/AGENTS.md`, `db/README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Records: `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` `D-P37.71-1` + obligation event `D-P37.71-1:e0` + RETURN PASS row `P37.71` (leg `P37.71-operator-purge-deploy`) + coverage re-routes (SIG-STORE-011 → `BL-070`, SIG-GOV-008 → `BL-065`; WAIVED verdicts stand per SIG-ENG-041).

## Gate answers (verbatim, never re-decided)
